scope: Exactly two existing weekly image contexts.

images.captionJa: 朝礼で聞いた搬入予定の変更を、自分たちの通路や段取りと照合する教材例。写真の保管方法を標準仕様として示すものではありません。
images.observation: Adults compare a blank delivery document with the real staging aisle and stored pipes. Route and material areas are distinguishable; no pictured rack arrangement is promoted as a storage standard.
images.method: Actual full image pixels viewed; exact Japanese cluster and independent full source page text and renders reviewed.

images.captionJa: 別の現場から来た作業者へ、今回の現場の区域や条件を説明する教材例。以前の入場証だけで説明済みとは扱いません。
images.observation: Experienced adult explains the present site boundary and access area to a new arrival holding an old badge. Visible barrier and clear walkway establish site-specific context without certifying induction by a badge.
images.method: Actual full image pixels viewed; exact Japanese cluster and independent full source page text and renders reviewed.
